_comment: Scenarios for outbound_dayresched/node_1_identity_confirm.txt (claude-haiku-4-5). Generated by experiments/outbound_haiku55/scenario_defs.py; `checks` are graded by experiments/outbound_haiku55/ob55.py (blind Agent(model=haiku) = Haiku 5.5 probes). Rewritten 2026-10-10 with the loose rewrite.

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Yes, speaking.
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Yes, is this about Thursday?
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Wrong number mate.

scenarios.name: THIRD PARTY -> not_available, nothing about the appointment

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
She's at work, I'm her flatmate.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Try again another time; not_available; no details.

scenarios.name: WHO IS THIS

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Sorry, who's this?

scenarios.expected_behavior: AI Jane from clinic; asks if they are Sam.

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
You've reached the voicemail of Sam. Leave a message after the beep.
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Hello — is anyone there?
Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
I'm on the road, can't talk.

scenarios.name: VOICEMAIL greeting that opens 'this is Sam' (also reads as a yes) -> silent no_answer, no pitch

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Hi, this is Sam. I can't get to the phone right now, so leave your name and number after the beep and I'll call you back.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Treats it as an answering machine: no speech, outcome no_answer. Must not read 'this is Sam' as the patient confirming.

scenarios.name: YES + 'I'm driving' -> the driving rule beats the yes rule: goodbye + not_available

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Yes, speaking — sorry, I'm driving at the moment, I'm on the freeway.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not stay silent (which would start the booking pitch to a driver); short goodbye with the clinic number and outcome not_available.

scenarios.name: HAND-OVER 'he's here, hold on, I'll grab him' -> waits, no wrong_number, nothing about the appointment

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Yeah he's here — hold on, I'll grab him. Sam! Phone for you!

scenarios.expected_behavior: Waits for the patient (silent or a short 'no problem, I'll hold'); never ends the call as wrong_number and never discloses the appointment.

scenarios.name: GUARDIAN answers for a child patient and asks what it is about -> no appointment details, no silent pass-through

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
This is Sam's mum — he's only nine, I look after all his appointments. What's this about?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says something (re-identifies and asks for Sam, or ends politely); must not say the practitioner, day, time or service, and must not stay silent (silence hands the call to the pitch, which names all of them).

scenarios.name: OFFER TO TAKE A MESSAGE from someone else -> declines politely, not_available, nothing about the appointment

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
He's asleep, he's on night shift. Do you want to leave a message with me instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Thanks them, says it will try another time, outcome not_available; does not pass any appointment detail through the third party.

scenarios.name: SUSPICIOUS patient refuses personal details -> re-identifies, never asks for details

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Who are you again? I'm not giving any personal details to some robot on the phone.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it is an AI assistant from the clinic / re-asks whether this is Sam; never asks for date of birth, address or any other detail; no tool.

scenarios.name: THIRD PARTY 'hold on, one sec' -> the identity table's hold line, not the call rules' 'take your time'

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Hold on, one sec.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it will hold ('Thank you, I'll hold.'); no tool call.

scenarios.name: 'NO, it's me' -> a yes: silent, no tool, no 'is he available?'

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
No — sorry, yes, it's me. I thought you were someone else.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Zero speech and no tool call: the platform moves on.

scenarios.name: BARE 'who?' -> the who-is-this line (identify + ask), not the vague line

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
Who?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Says it is AI Jane calling from Northside Physio trying to reach Sam and asks whether they are Sam; no tool call.

scenarios.name: 'I'm in a meeting' (no yes) -> can't-talk-now goodbye + not_available

history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling about your upcoming appointment that needs to be moved — is this Sam?
I'm in a meeting right now.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Short 'another time' goodbye and outcome not_available; no 30-seconds retry.
